scope_excludes: ignored/untracked generated data and local caches
reference_scan_scope: all tracked repository files at source HEAD; audit rows remain the requested artifact prefixes

json_recursive_scan.scope: all keys and values; exact tracked paths and raw SHA-256 values mapped to source and JSON pointer where present

reference_scan_notes: Exact path, script/test/doc/workflow references are retained per row from the all-tracked-source scan.
Immutable manifest/receipt path and hash references are retained separately per row.
Basename and related-directory references are recorded for non-exact historical documentation where they affect deletion proof.

The three deleted artifacts have zero exact path or raw-hash references in retained manifests/receipts and zero exact path references in the retained tracked repository; historical directory/basename mentions remain provenance only.
post_cleanup_size_basis: Git-normalized tracked artifact bytes; checkout CRLF smudging is excluded from cleanup delta
inventory_format: compact per-artifact JSON; references are deduplicated source:path/line or source:JSON-pointer strings
